Title: Grounded Protein Folding Study

Abstract
We evaluate transformer attention for protein residue graph folding with careful controls and baselines.

Methods
In a controlled study we apply transformer attention over residue graphs for folding prediction using cross-validation on one hundred thousand structures with ablation on attention heads and residual connections across three random seeds in the laboratory pipeline.

Results
Accuracy reached ninety percent on the CASP14 benchmark suite versus strong published baselines under identical splits.

Claims
Transformer attention improves folding prediction accuracy on CASP14.
Accuracy reached ninety percent on the CASP14 benchmark suite versus strong baselines.
